name: hlzd-cross-border-b2b
description: Agent skills for B2B industrial exporters — market research, lead finding, inquiry qualification, quotation, compliance and more. By 海联智达 (HLZD) / 海良数科.

metadata.author: HLZD (海联智达 / 海良数科)

plugins.name: hlzd-inquiry-qualify
plugins.description: Parse B2B industrial RFQ emails and score across 5 dimensions (A/B/C/D), generate clarification questions, and route to next skill. Multi-language (en/zh/es/ar/ru/pt) extraction. Zero-dependency Python CLI.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-b2b-research
plugins.description: End-to-end B2B industrial export market research pipeline: HS code lookup (hsbianma.com) + UN Comtrade market size + Google Trends demand heat + DDGS buyer leads + tender tracking. Outputs structured JSON and Markdown report.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-buyer-finder
plugins.description: 3-link buyer finding pipeline (Alibaba + Volza + public directory) for B2B industrial export. Auto-discover Chinese competitors on Alibaba, then find their overseas importers via Volza customs data. Outputs structured JSON with dedup-by-company + value-sorted importers.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-market-report
plugins.description: 9-section self-contained HTML market intelligence report generator for B2B industrial export. Cover + TOC + signals + platforms + comparison + actions + methodology + sources. Inputs from hlzd-b2b-research JSON or raw web signals. Voice contract LAWS enforced.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-customer-due-diligence
plugins.description: 5-dimension customer back-ground check (real-company / size / customer-type / procurement / risk) scoring A/B/C/D + OFAC SDN static subset + sanctioned-country + dual-use + fraud signal coarse-screening. Auto-route to hlzd-cold-outreach or hlzd-trade-compliance.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-cold-outreach
plugins.description: Cold email + Day 7/Day 14 follow-up sequence generator for B2B buyers. 6 buyer-type templates (Manufacturer / EPC / Distributor / OEM / End User / Trader) x 2 languages (en/es). Variable substitution + word-limit checks. Receives outputs from hlzd-customer-due-diligence.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-solution-match
plugins.description: B2B industrial inquiry solution matcher — input inquiry (product + qty + certs + application + lead time) + product catalog -> 3 plans (best_match / alternative / cost_effective) with 5-dim match scoring (spec / qty / lead / price-tier / risk) + risk flags.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-quotation-gen
plugins.description: Industrial B2B quotation generator — input SKU + qty + target country + incoterm -> 3 incoterm prices (FOB / CIF / DDP) with cost breakdown + profit health check + payment terms suggestion. Multi-currency + region-aware freight estimation.
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-negotiation-playbook
plugins.description: B2B price concession simulator — input initial quote + customer counter-offer + redlines -> 3-round concession path (price / lead-time / payment) with breach alerts + decision recommendation (accept_round_2 / counter / counter_with_freight / walk_away / accept_round_3).
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-trade-compliance
plugins.description: B2B trade compliance guardrail - 4+1 checks (OFAC SDN / EU Consolidated / BIS Entity List / Country-Based Embargo / ECCN dual-use keyword) producing CLEARED / PENDING_REVIEW / BLOCKED clearance with full audit trail and Markdown report. Static subsets of OFAC/EU/BIS sanctions (80 entries) ready for production API swap to real-time feeds (OFAC SDN.csv / EU CFSP / BIS CSL).
plugins.author: HLZD

plugins.name: hlzd-daily-report
plugins.description: B2B 业务员日报自动化 —— LangBot 事件采集 + LLM 摘要 + 飞书卡片推送 + 次日 8:00 早会总结。ActivityWatch + Inbox Zero + LangBot 三方借鉴。
plugins.author: HLZD
